name: Osananajimi Yuka ~Yuujin ni Zecchoo Kairaku o Kizamitsukerarete Iku Motokano Osananajimi~
original_name: 幼馴染み・結花 ～友人に絶頂快楽を刻みつけられていく元カノ幼馴染み～
source:
Kouji Ihama and Yuka Suzueda are childhood friends. They had dated a few times in the past. However, they went through a cycle of getting together and breaking up, and even after having a physical relationship during their final time together, they couldn’t shake the feeling that something was off about their current dynamic. They realized they couldn’t be lovers, and ended up breaking up. And they thought they could never go back to being just childhood friends…

Later, after moving to Tokyo together to attend college, the two grew closer again, and began spending a lot of time together as childhood friends, just like before. While finding joy in their daily lives—a relationship they’d once lost and thought was gone for good—they decided they wouldn’t become lovers again and wanted to remain just childhood friends.

One day, Kouji’s classmate, Daiki Nakashige, confided in him that he had feelings for Yuka.
Knowing Daiki was a good guy, Kouji encouraged him to confess his feelings. Eventually, Yuka confided in him that Daiki had confessed his feelings to her, and he encouraged her to accept him as well. After all, he knew he could never be her boyfriend again… So the two began dating, but they vowed to continue their relationship as childhood friends, just as they had always been. Later, even after learning that Yuka and Daiki had become physically intimate,
he felt a stir in his heart, but he had no choice but to deny that the emotion was jealousy.

Eventually, Daiki learns that Yuka’s ex-boyfriend is Kouji, and, sensing that Kouji’s presence still lingers within her, he feels intense jealousy. And in order to claim both Yuka’s heart and body,
he begins to flaunt their own physical relationship in front of Kouji—

translation:
伊滨晃二与铃枝结花是一对青梅竹马，过去也曾交往过几次。然而两人几度分分合合，即便在最后一次复合期间发生了肉体关系，也依然无法抹去彼此相处时那股莫名的违和感。他们意识到两人终究无法成为恋人，最终还是选择了分手，并以为再也回不到单纯的青梅竹马关系了……

后来，两人一同前往东京上大学，距离再度拉近，又像从前那样以青梅竹马的身份形影不离地相处起来。这段曾一度失去、原以为再也无法挽回的日常让他们倍感欣喜，两人也因此决定不再重蹈覆辙成为恋人，只想一直维持纯粹的青梅竹马关系。

某天，晃二的同班同学中茂大辉向他吐露心声，表示自己喜欢上了结花。
晃二深知大辉为人不错，便鼓励他去表白。不久后，结花也找晃二商量被大辉告白的事，晃二同样劝她接受这份心意——毕竟他很清楚，自己已经不可能再做她的男朋友了……就这样，大辉与结花正式开始交往，而晃二与结花也约定今后依然像往常一样做青梅竹马。后来，即便得知结花与大辉已经有了肌肤之亲，
晃二心中虽泛起一阵波澜，却也只能拼命否认这份感情是嫉妒。

然而大辉终究得知了结花的前男友正是晃二，并敏锐地察觉到结花心中仍留有晃二的影子，由此燃起了强烈的嫉妒心。为了彻底占有结花的身心，
他开始在晃二面前肆意炫耀两人之间的肉体关系——
